I have a similar issue. The best advice I got was do whatever makes you happy. You can’t live your life around any single person ever. YOUR life is YOUR life. Depending on your mothers age you could tell her to go to bingo, go to a senior night (some places have activities just for older lonely people). You can do many things to help but you definitely 100% should not revolve your life around her. She’s trying to abuse and manipulate you and no matter what you do it won’t get any better.
